detail.longDescription: TalorData MCP server: built on @modelcontextprotocol/sdk, exposes search, history, statistics tools. Uses streamable-http transport for Claude Desktop remote config. Per-request token validation — no shared upstream key. Three integrations cover the full stack: n8n (automation workflows) → LangChain (AI Agent frameworks) → MCP (standardized tool-calling). # n8n # LangChain # MCP # SERPAPI # devtools
